data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for custom particle effects using CustomPainter and drawAtlas.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to add high-performance custom particle effects to their Flutter UI. Uses an onTick handler to manage a list of particles and updates them frame by frame.
use_when: You need custom particle effects in your UI
You want high performance rendering using CustomPainter and drawAtlas
avoid_when: You need pre-made standard UI animations rather than custom particles
strengths: Extensible architecture with a straightforward onTick callback
weaknesses: Requires manual management of the particle list and lifecycle in code
